annotations.title: Poland vs OECD countries: pension replacement rates and tax wedge (OECD)

description: Use to compare Polish pensions (replacement rate) or labour taxes (tax wedge) with OECD countries, also countries outside the EU such as the United States, the United Kingdom or Japan. For the tax wedge in EU countries, use get_eu_earnings. For a pension forecast by birth year, use get_pension_forecast. OECD comparative data. Pension replacement rates from Pensions at a Glance: first pension as % of individual earnings before retirement, net and gross, men and women, average wage, full career from age 22, mandatory schemes, for Poland, the OECD average and every country of the OECD comparison, with the rank of Poland and finwire_oecd_pension_gap (Poland minus the OECD average, percentage points). Tax wedge from Taxing Wages: income tax plus employee and employer social contributions as % of total labour costs for six household profiles in every OECD country (also outside the EU: United States, United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, Switzerland, Norway), history of Poland and the OECD average since 2000, and finwire_oecd_tax_wedge_gap. For the tax wedge in EU countries from Eurostat use get_eu_earnings. For a pension forecast for a birth cohort use get_pension_forecast.

profile.description: Tax wedge household profile, default single_100 (single person without children, average wage).

topic.description: pension (replacement rates) or tax-wedge; default both.
